_JAYDEN_READ_ME: Before uploading, replace AW-XXXXXXXXXX and the two PASTE_ labels with the real values from Google Ads > Goals > Conversions > (action) > Tag setup > Install the tag yourself. Tag ID looks like AW-123456789; the label is the text after the slash in send_to (e.g. AW-123456789/AbC-dEfGhIjK -> label AbC-dEfGhIjK). While any placeholder is left in, the Google tag does not load at all (safe).
